# PerchTV 0.1.7

Every start now checks for a new version.

## WHAT CHANGED

- The television checked for updates at most once every 12 hours, and a check you never saw still counted — so restarting, force closing and clearing the cache could not make a prompt appear. Now every start checks, always. The 12-hour quiet period only limits repeat checks while the app stays open, which is where it belongs.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including 0.1.6's provider knock and patience.
